title: Mermaid config
description: mermaid-config.json: the only place the Mermaid render settings live. The settings that keep the output safe and the same on every machine are fixed here with `const`, so a change to one of them is a setup error, not a quiet change. The colors are checked against the design system by tests/mermaid-config.test.ts.

look.description: classic is the same on every run; a hand-drawn look is random without a seed.

handDrawnSeed.description: Fixes the random numbers of the hand-drawn shapes, in case a look uses them.

fontFamily.description: Mermaid measures the width of a text with this list (and with sans-serif, whichever is wider), and a sequence diagram reads no other. It starts with the bundled font, so the layout does not depend on the fonts of the machine.

theme.description: base takes every color from themeVariables.

themeVariables.description: Colors from the design system and the font of the layout.

fontFamily.description: Starts with the font that the renderer bundles, so the layout does not depend on the fonts of the machine.

htmlLabels.description: false writes labels as SVG text; true writes foreignObject.

bundledFont.description: A font list that starts with the font that the renderer bundles.

useMaxWidth.description: false gives the SVG a width and a height in pixels instead of 100%.
